description: Runs the prison side of The Rock (data/locations/the-rock.json) -- who is held in which of the nine cells, on whose authority, and under what conditions. Deliberately not one of the Directorate's three visible poles (Commander/Caretaker/Transparency Advocate): The Rock is classified Omega-Zero specifically because most Directorate staff don't know it exists, and giving it a publicly-known face would undercut that.
